title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Two weeks before Mizuki's birthday
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not seeing KAITO or MEIKO, but I guess there's nothing I can do about those two.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, everyone!
Thank you all for gathering here today♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So Mizuki got you all together too, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, to ask us for a big favor...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? A big favor?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'd like to ask you all to keep your schedules open on the 27th. There's somewhere I wanna go.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki, isn't that your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's right! And I want to spend it with all of you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll make sure to keep that day open.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But where do you want to go?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You'll just have to wait until the day of♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You called us together for this, which means we're free to go with you, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! There's gonna be a lot of people there, so we won't be able to constantly be together...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I still wanna hang out there with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Let us know when it's time, then.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... I'm really excited about going, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too!
Mizuki's birthday
SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, here we are! SpoJoy Park!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So this is where you wanted to go.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's safe to come out, everyone.
You should be able to hide behind all of us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's very lively.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Look at all the people...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Still, why did you want to come here?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This place may feel strange and new to us, but that isn't the case for you and the others, Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, we do come here from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you have your eye on some birthday special?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. There is that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I really just wanted to hang out here with you guys. We haven't been here with this group before, after all!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh... That's all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! That's all!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You guys are gonna keep me company until I'm satisfied!

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Mafuyu & Ena
rows.Line:
Okay.
Alright, fine.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We're gonna start by taking some pics!
I need to go borrow the birthday hat and sash!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, they do have those here, don't they...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You want to put them on? But they're so lame.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If that's what Mizuki wants, then I don't see a problem with it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Are there enough for us as well?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Why do you want to put them on, Luka...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, roller blading's so much fun!
The rush of wind as you go is just the best♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Can you guys also feel it, Miku, Len?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Umm... I can tell that you're going very fast.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How are you so good at this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's probably easy after you do it a few times.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But we've already done it a few times too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can do it, Kanade, Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, instead of having fun all by yourself, come help us!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Swing for the fences! Ka-na-de!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: N-Now...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. You swung far too late.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You've gotta swing sooner, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That's amazing, Mafuyu.
You've hit every ball so far.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, is it just me or was that ball just now really fast?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I put it on the highest setting. To try it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, cool! Lemme give that a go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Phew... We did quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, let's take a quick break here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We'll also head back and take a break.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Umm... See you later, Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's play more later!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What are we going to do after our break?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, our extra guests should be arriving soon, so something we can do with a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Extra guests?
se_walk_men_002_4
We're here, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ah!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks for coming, you guys!
Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I heard that Emu and Kusanagi were busy, but where are An and Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, we were all together initially, but something came up and they had to take a detour.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They said that they'd join us soon and to get started without them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We'll do any activity you wish!
After all, you're the star of today's show!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much♪
In that case... Oh, let's play strike zone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We have enough people to form two teams, so why don't the losers buy drinks for the winners?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, that sounds fine.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, Mizuki, but I'd like to rest for a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then, I'll rest with you.
That'll make it easier to split the headcount, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You just don't wanna lose and buy drinks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are so close.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Anyway, we'll start after we make our teams!
